goal.vi: Mô tả triệu chứng, báo dị ứng và hỏi cách dùng thuốc.
goal.en: Describe how you feel, mention allergies and ask how to take medicine.

lines: Hello, come in. What seems to be the problem?
I've had a bad headache since yesterday.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have a fever?
A little. I also feel really tired.
No, nothing. I'm allergic to penicillin, by the way.
Thanks for telling me. It looks like a virus. Rest and drink lots of water.
How often should I take this?

phrases.say: I've had a headache since yesterday.

mean.vi: Nói một vấn đề sức khỏe bắt đầu từ khi nào
mean.en: Say when a health problem started

why.vi: Dùng "I've had… since…" cho việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ và vẫn còn; nhớ thêm "a".
why.en: Use "I've had… since…" for something that started in the past and continues; add "a".

phrases.not: I am feeling not good in my body.

mean.vi: Nói bạn cảm thấy thế nào

why.vi: Giữ đơn giản: "I feel" + tính từ (tired, sick, dizzy).
why.en: Keep it simple: "I feel" + an adjective (tired, sick, dizzy).

phrases.not: It is pain when I swallow.

mean.vi: Nói chỗ nào đau và đau khi nào

why.vi: "Pain" là danh từ; dùng động từ "hurts": "It hurts when…"
why.en: "Pain" is a noun; use the verb: "It hurts when…"

mean.vi: Báo bạn bị dị ứng với thứ gì
mean.en: Say what you are allergic to

why.vi: Nói "allergic to" + tên thứ đó. Luôn báo bác sĩ về dị ứng.
why.en: Say "allergic to" + the thing. Always tell the doctor about allergies.

phrases.say: How often should I take this?
phrases.not: How many time I drink this medicine?

mean.vi: Hỏi uống thuốc bao nhiêu lần
mean.en: Ask how many times to take medicine

why.vi: "How often…?" hỏi về tần suất; thuốc thì dùng "take", không phải "drink".
why.en: "How often…?" asks about frequency; we "take" medicine, not "drink" pills.

phrases.say: I'd like to make an appointment, please.
phrases.not: I want to meet the doctor.

mean.en: Book a time to see the doctor

why.vi: "Make an appointment" là cụm cố định để đặt lịch khám.
why.en: "Make an appointment" is the set phrase for booking a time with a doctor.

phrases.say: Sorry, could you explain that in simpler words?

mean.vi: Nhờ giải thích bằng từ dễ hơn

why.vi: Từ y khoa khó với mọi người; xin giải thích dễ hơn là thông minh, không bất lịch sự.
why.en: Medical words are hard for everyone; asking for simpler words is smart, not rude.

ai.name: Dr. Lee
ai.goal: find out the learner's symptoms and give advice

roleplay.you: Explain your headache, say how you feel, mention your allergy and ask how to take the medicine.

turns.a: Hello, come in. What seems to be the problem?
turns.h: I've had a bad headache since yesterday.
br: A headache. I'm sorry to hear that.

turns.a: Do you have a fever or any other symptoms?
turns.h: A little fever. I also feel really tired.

turns.a: Are you allergic to any medicine?
It looks like a virus. I'll give you something for the pain. Any questions?
turns.h: How often should I take it?

roleplay.end: Rest and drink lots of water. Come back if you don't feel better in three days.
